root_idea.summary: The root centers on freshness or immaturity—being before a thing has reached its proper stage—and also carries a separate orientation of stillness or restricted movement.
root_idea.development: From the idea of freshness and being before ripeness, the lexicon develops usages for premature action, seeking, or treatment. A related branch describes a contracted or fixed facial expression, including frowning and stern dislike.

senses.definition: To frown, scowl, or contract the face.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the frown is displayed before its proper time or in an inappropriate situation, conveying an inopportune or deliberate expression of displeasure.

senses.definition: Frowning, contracted in expression, and showing stern dislike or aversion.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the feminine form بَاسِرَةٌ in the construction وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ for faces marked by this expression. Its temporal nuance is associated with a state anticipating what will befall them before the final outcome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or use something while it is fresh, juicy, moist, or still firm; specifically, to pasture animals on fresh herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verbal usage concerning the freshness or lack of flaccidity of the thing used.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten, undertake, seek, or demand something before its proper time, or in an improper place or manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Constructions include requiring a debt before it is due, drinking milk before it thickens, and breaking or opening a pustule before it ripens.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mate with, deflower, or fertilize before the female or organism is ready.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a stallion covering a female before the onset of desire, to defloration before puberty, and to fertilizing a palm before the proper time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dig for or seek water when it is scarce.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This includes digging a well in the dry bed of a river.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To begin a thing or begin with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may be construed with the thing introduced or begun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mix unripe dates with other dates in a fermented or prepared date beverage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage concerns making the beverage by combining full-grown unripe dates with ripe or dry dates, or mixing them into a preparation made from dry dates.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a mare, to desire the stallion when sexual excitement has only just begun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction describes desire before the mare is fully aroused.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dig into ground that has not previously been dug.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived Form IV usage concerning newly opened or untouched ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of palm trees, to bear dates that remain in the full-grown unripe stage or fail to ripen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive usage describing the state or production of the palm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek recently produced fresh water or to dig for plants before they emerge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage concerns newly available water after rain and plants still below the surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a wild bull, to reach the roots of dry plants and eat them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form V usage describing feeding at the roots of dried vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a color to change and become like the color of full-grown unripe dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is applied to a person's or thing's color.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fresh, juicy, moist, or firm material; especially fresh herbage that has just risen from the ground and is not yet tall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine form بُسْرَةٌ may be used for a single instance or for a corresponding feminine description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fresh water recently produced by rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A variant may denote cold or cool water; the plural of the rain-fresh water sense is بِسَارٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young, youthful, or fresh person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can describe a male or female, including a boy or girl, without restricting the meaning to one gender.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sun just after rising, while red and not yet clear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine noun describing the early appearance of the sun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Full-grown but unripe dates that have begun to take on color before becoming ripe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term covers dates in the stage between green growth and ripeness; the related singular is بُسْرَةٌ or بُسُرَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The head or extremity of a dog's penis.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of bead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object noun, synonymous with خَرَزَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A swelling or tumor associated especially with hemorrhoids or piles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also denote analogous swellings in other bodily locations; the source records a variant pronunciation with ص.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree whose dates do not ripen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the phrase نَخْلَةٌ مِبْسَارٌ, with the adjective functioning as a possessive-style epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affected by the disease called بَوَاسِير, hemorrhoids or piles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial adjective describing a person afflicted by that disease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mare's desire for the stallion at the beginning of sexual excitement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes desire before the mare is fully aroused.

cautions: The public nominal headword is normalized to the masculine active-participial citation form بَاسِرٌ; the Quranic occurrence itself is the feminine form بَاسِرَةٌ.
The Form IV Lane entry is transmitted with the headword ايسر in the packet, while its lexical unit reads ابسر النخل; it is normalized here as أَبْسَرَ based on the unit text.
